title: From Safe Parking Program to Home for the Holidays
description:
Home for the holidays. 🎁🏠 San Diego native Ashley and her kids moved into a new apartment this past October after experiencing homelessness and receiving help at the City's Safe Parking Program. Jewish Family Service of San Diego (JFS) operates the program, which aims to connect those living in their vehicles back into housing.

Ashley and her family stayed at the Rose Canyon site, where the City provides camper trailers for families. JFS helped her get her security guard license and she now works full-time supporting her family in their new home. 

Congratulations on the hard work and future milestones, Ashley! 🎉 

#sandiego
